name: Optical Reef
subtitle: Autonomously assembled space telescope
description: A modular three-mirror anastigmat with independent hexagonal mirror spacecraft, a free-flying detector platform, formation control and computational wavefront correction.
notes: Rings follows hex_mirror.html: 1 = central segment only; 2 = center plus one surrounding ring (7 segments). Workbook main!B3=1 counts surrounding rings, so it is represented as 2 here.

F2F is the distance across opposite flats. The workbook used F2F/2 as a circumradius. The corrected segment area is sqrt(3)/2 × F2F², rather than 3sqrt(3)/8 × F2F². All area-driven calculations use the corrected geometry.
Headline mass and power are known subtotals. TBD values remain null and mark results incomplete. No design margins, operating modes, or reliability-count models are applied.

Per-segment totals cover each mirror spacecraft. Observatory totals add the one-off free-flying science/detector platform separately. The 200 kg workbook science-instrumentation allowance is assigned to that platform pending confirmation.
The 1.6 kg / 10.5 W FGS entry occurs in both Payload and ACS. It is counted once in ACS pending confirmation that these are distinct units.
C&DH includes the separate Instrumentation computer line. Its possible overlap with the ACS computer remains unresolved.
